title: 1 – GENERAL
officialText: 1.1 SCOPE.—This standard covers ceiling suspension systems used primarily to support acoustical tile or acoustical lay-in panels weighing less than four pounds per square foot, not contributing to the fire-resistance rating of a floor or roof assembly and not used for meeting the noise control requirements of the building code.
